debug_kernel_api: debug a Python function to log kernel API inputs, outputs, and exceptions with configurable log levels
debug_torch_op: debug a torch.ops function by wrapping it with kernel API logging and redirecting its function name
wrap_method_with_debug_kernel_once: wrap a method on a Python object with kernel API debug logging while preventing double-wrapping
dump_function_inputs: dump function inputs and kwargs to disk as tensors and metadata for crash debugging
dump_function_outputs: dump function return values to an existing dump directory for post-mortem analysis
